**Reader-data format**: sequence of "chunks", each prefixed with a 2-byte little-endian (host-order) uint16 length. 
- Chunk 0 = ATR (connect).
- Each subsequent cardi/o (transmit) consumes one chunk: last 2 bytes = sw1, sw2; preceding bytes = response data copied into apdu->resp up to apdu->resplen.

```c
if (chunk_size <= apdu->resplen)

apdu->sw1 = chunk[size-2]; apdu.sw2 = chunk[size-1];
```
